# UI patterns
## Use this when
Building frontend islands, reusable base components, or accessible interactions.
## Rule
Use semantic design tokens, semantic HTML, keyboard-complete interaction, visible focus, and reusable base components for shared behavior.
## Do
- Preserve accessible names and reduced-motion preferences.
## Do not
- Do not hard-code palette values inside feature islands.
